node.statement: The verifier objection is accepted: failure of the literal nonsquare pair and one zero-padding construction does not prove an exhaustive impossibility or a necessary-remedy theorem. Those assertions have therefore been removed rather than defended. The added registry dependency lem-compcb-row-column-product supplies a different direct argument that requires neither a square embedding nor E_11 matrix-norm or compression-naturality identifications.
